metadata.name: pangu
metadata.description: Rules for a fair first sale of a stock token on Meteora DBC

docs: Pangu holds the rules of a stock token's first sale on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding
Curve: a cap per wallet, an optional issuer-approved buyer list, an optional
ceiling against the real stock's live price, and no wallet-to-wallet movement
until the sale is over. DBC finds the price, Pangu decides who may receive
tokens and how many.

accounts.name: rules
docs: offering period is over, and only when the bytes are a SaleRules in a
layout this build reads. Anything else, including rules written by an
older build, reads as "not over" and leaves the two older ways in exactly
as they were, so this account can never stop a close that worked before.

accounts.name: pool
docs: owning program, the length and the discriminator before any field is used.

accounts.name: mint
docs: owning program is checked there before the bytes are read.

accounts.name: credential
docs: key named in `credential`, owned by the attestation service, and to carry
the credential discriminator. Refused outright in the other modes.

accounts.name: schema
docs: key named in `schema`, owned by the attestation service, to belong to
`credential`, and not to be paused. Refused outright in the other modes.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: template this pool names, owned by DBC and of the right kind. Its fee mode
and the supply its curve sells decide whether the sale may open at all, and
it names the paying token.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Required in every mode. Must be the paying token the template names. It is
stored in the rules, its freeze authority is checked, and on a banded sale
its decimals are stored so the hook can turn a curve price into dollars
without being handed a mint at buy time.

accounts.name: extra_account_meta_list
docs: seeds the transfer-hook interface requires, and `init` makes it single-use.

accounts.name: source_token
docs: owning program is checked. Nothing is read from it before that.

accounts.name: mint
docs: the rules account is proven to be the one derived from it.

accounts.name: destination_token
docs: owning program is checked.

accounts.name: authority
docs: because a signature proves nothing about who is allowed to receive tokens.

accounts.name: extra_account_meta_list
docs: Token-2022 resolves the extra accounts from it before the call. Pangu itself
reads nothing out of it, so it is carried, not trusted.

accounts.name: destination_record
docs: program, discriminator, mint and wallet are all checked by hand below.

accounts.name: source_record
docs: program, discriminator, mint and wallet are all checked by hand below.

errors.name: NotTransferring
errors.msg: Token-2022 is not mid-transfer on both token accounts

errors.name: ReceivingAccountOwnerCanChange
errors.msg: the receiving token account's owner can still be changed

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the account does not belong to this sale's mint

errors.name: WrongBuyerRecord
errors.msg: the buyer record is not the one for this wallet

errors.name: BuyerRecordMissing
errors.msg: this wallet has no buyer record yet

errors.name: NotApproved
errors.msg: this wallet is not on the issuer's approved list

errors.name: CredentialInvalid
errors.msg: the attestation is not valid for this wallet, credential and schema

errors.name: CredentialExpired
errors.msg: the attestation has expired

errors.name: CredentialSignerNotAuthorized
errors.msg: the key that signed the attestation is no longer an authorized signer

errors.name: OverCap
errors.msg: this buy would take the wallet over the per-wallet cap

errors.name: WalletToWalletDuringSale
errors.msg: the token cannot move between wallets while the sale is running

errors.name: PriceStale
errors.msg: the reference price is too old, missing or not a positive number

errors.name: PriceOutsideBand
errors.msg: the price is outside the allowed band

errors.name: WrongPriceAccount
errors.msg: the price account is not the one named in the rules, or does not hold a usable price

errors.name: PriceNotFullyVerified
errors.msg: the price update has not been signed by two thirds of the guardians

errors.name: PriceTooUncertain
errors.msg: the price carries a wider confidence interval than this sale accepts

errors.name: NotPoolCreator
errors.msg: the signer did not create this pool

errors.name: NotAHookPool
errors.msg: the account is not a DBC transfer-hook pool

errors.name: HookProgramMismatch
errors.msg: the mint's transfer hook does not name this program

errors.name: MintAuthorityStillSet
errors.msg: someone can still mint this token, which would go straight past the cap

errors.name: WrongLaunchTemplate
errors.msg: the launch template is not the one this pool was opened on

errors.name: FeesNotInQuoteToken
errors.msg: the launch template collects fees in the sale token instead of the paying token

errors.name: ZeroCap
errors.msg: the cap must be above zero

errors.name: InvalidAccessMode
errors.msg: that access mode is not available

errors.name: InvalidBand
errors.msg: the price band settings are incomplete, out of range, or set on a sale that has no band

errors.name: SaleStillRunning
errors.msg: the sale is still running, the mint still names this program as its hook

errors.name: NotIssuer
errors.msg: only the issuer can do this

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: the counter would overflow

errors.name: WrongLayoutVersion
errors.msg: these sale rules were written by another layout of the program

errors.name: BandNeedsDollarQuote
errors.msg: a price band needs buyers to pay in a dollar token on this network's list

errors.name: IssuerControlsPayingToken
errors.msg: the issuer can freeze the paying token, which would let them stop sellers being paid

errors.name: CapCoversWholeSale
errors.msg: the cap is at or above everything the curve sells, so it limits nobody

errors.name: EndInThePast
errors.msg: the offering period would end at a time that has already passed

types.name: BuyerRecord
docs: One wallet's standing in one sale. Keyed on the wallet that owns the token
account, never on the token account, so extra token accounts share one cap.

fields.name: net_bought
docs: Tokens received from the pool minus tokens sold back to it.

types.name: PriceBand
docs: The price band settings, passed to `create_sale` as one value.
They travel together because they are only meaningful together: the price
account's address is derived from the shard id and the feed id, so changing
either one changes which account the hook must read.

fields.name: band_bps
docs: How far above the live stock price a buy may leave the curve price, in
basis points. Zero switches the whole band off.

fields.name: price_account
docs: The Pyth price feed account. Must be the address the shard id and the feed
id below produce under Pyth's price feed program.

fields.name: price_feed_id
docs: The Pyth feed carrying the stock price in dollars.

fields.name: price_shard
docs: Which of Pyth's shards this sale reads. A shard is just a second copy of
the same feed at a second address, so a sale can depend on a price its own
refresher keeps fresh rather than on Pyth's sponsored one.

fields.name: max_price_age_secs
docs: How old the published price may be on a buy, in seconds.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: The widest confidence interval this sale will buy against, in basis points
of the price itself.

fields.name: ends_at
docs: Unix seconds when the offering period ends and every rule lifts. Zero
means the rules hold until graduation.

types.name: SaleRules
docs: The rules of one sale. Written once at creation and never changed: there is no
update instruction, which is what makes the cap a promise instead of a setting.

fields.name: base_vault
docs: The pool's base token vault, read out of the pool account at creation. The
hook tells a buy from a sell by comparing against this one address.

fields.name: issuer
docs: The pool creator. The only key that can approve or revoke buyers.

fields.name: cap
docs: Most tokens one wallet may hold net of sells, in raw units.

fields.name: credential
docs: Mode 2 only: the attestation credential whose approvals count. Zero
otherwise. Sits at byte 145 of the account, and the hook's extra accounts
are derived by reading it there, so it can never move.

fields.name: schema
docs: Mode 2 only: the attestation schema that counts. Zero otherwise. Sits at
byte 177 of the account, read the same way.

fields.name: price_account
docs: Band only: the Pyth price feed account, at byte 209. Zero otherwise.

fields.name: price_feed_id
docs: Band only: the Pyth feed the price account must carry, at byte 241.

fields.name: price_shard
docs: Band only: the Pyth shard the price account was derived under.

fields.name: band_bps
docs: Zero means no band.

fields.name: base_decimals
docs: Read off the two mints at creation, so the curve price can be turned into
dollars per whole token without trusting anything passed at buy time.

fields.name: buyers
docs: Wallets whose record is above zero right now.

fields.name: total_net_bought
docs: Sum of every record, so the app can show the largest holder's share.

fields.name: layout_version
docs: Which layout wrote this account, at byte 298. It takes the first of what
used to be the spare bytes, so the account is the same size and every
field in front of it sits exactly where it always did. A sale opened
before this byte existed reads as version 0, which is how a reader tells
the two apart instead of reading one layout's bytes as the other's.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The token buyers pay in, read from the launch template at creation, at
byte 299. Layout 2 onwards; a version 1 account holds zeros here.

fields.name: ends_at
docs: Unix seconds at which the offering period ends, at byte 331. From then on
every rule lifts and the token moves freely, so a curve that never fills
cannot hold the token in place for good. Zero means no end: the rules hold
until graduation. Fixed at creation like every other rule.
